ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of mid-to-high intensity (light gray/white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and encompasses the median notch area. Mid-intensity gray mottling covers the interior of both lobes. High-intensity white clusters are concentrated on the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; vertical depth is approximately 12-15% of the total fluke height with a sharp internal convergence angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies significantly, with the most pronounced vertical deviations located on the medial-half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending laterally, transitioning to a slight upward concavity at the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacle colonies) located on the extreme left and right terminal tips and at several peaks along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across both lobes; notable diagonal orientations on the right lobe and vertical/oblique orientations on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and calcified barnacle clusters localized on the distal trailing edges and tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated, high-intensity white circular focal spot located in the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
